title: %rank - assign ranks to values
purpose: Tag each element with a _rank field (ties share a rank).
notes: Default direction is descending, so the largest value is rank 1.
The array is supplied as a JSON-array string so the added _rank field surfaces in the output.

avoid.why: a typed ODIN array block wraps each element, so the added _rank field is dropped from the serialized output; supply the array as a JSON-array string literal instead
